channel.title: The Art Newspaper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: ‘No one was really interested in finding those works’: major Brazilian art theft still unsolved as statute of limitations expires
item.description: Paintings by Monet, Matisse, Dalí and Picasso were snatched in a cinematic heist from Rio de Janeiro’s Museu da Chácara do Céu in 2006

item.title: The Big Review | The Woman Question 1550-2025 ★★★★½
item.description: Works spanning centuries have been brought together in an exhibition highlighting how hard-fought women’s rights are under constant threat

item.title: Towering cost: Tracey Emin hit with £160,000 bill to fix Margate flats
item.description: The artist, who owns four properties in the Margate Brutalist block, has been told to pay £160,000 bill to replace cladding

item.title: Henry Moore and Dorothea Tanning set records at Christie's triple-header sale in London
item.description: The evening brought in £197m, a 52% increase on last year's equivalent auctions

item.title: Leading Russian archaeologist arrested in Poland over Crimean excavations
item.description: Ukraine has requested the extradition of the State Hermitage Museum’s Alexander Butyagin, who seized artefacts including ancient Greek coins

item.title: Did Van Gogh’s Yellow House turn blue after his death?
item.description: Before the artist’s former home was bombed in the war, two little-known paintings in the 1930s depicted its exterior in an unexpected colour

item.title: Pussy Riot slams Russia’s return to Venice Biennale
item.description: Russia’s decision to put on a show in Venice has prompted criticism from Russian dissidents and Ukrainian artists

item.title: War in the Middle East, the Whitney Biennial, and a newly-discovered Rembrandt in Amsterdam—podcast
item.description: Ben Luke talks to The Art Newspaper's Melissa Gronlund about the outbreak of war in a region that has invested heavily in arts and culture, while Ben Sutton discusses the 82nd Whitney Biennial in New York. Plus, a newly-discovered Rembrandt at the Rijksmuseum.

item.title: UK presenters Ant and Dec take legal action over 'secret and unauthorised £250,000 profit' made from Banksy prints
item.description: The duo has won a court order to force an art dealer to reveal details of his transactions with an unnamed intermediary

item.title: ‘A gilded edifice to one man’s ego’: critics pile on at public hearing on Trump’s White House ballroom plans
item.description: The National Capital Planning Commission, widely expected to approve the plans, will hold its final vote in April
